capabilities: Renders notes as stars orbiting a central 3D black hole
Groups notes by top-level folders, tags or linked-note clusters
Opens notes by clicking their star
Updates the map live as notes are added, renamed, linked or deleted
Builds a standalone HTML map from any folder of Markdown files
disambiguation: Not a second-brain or note-taking system; it only visualizes existing notes as a 3D map, with no AI or sync.
extras: Desktop-only (Windows, Mac, Linux); the standalone HTML export embeds full note text, so don't share it; automation (Notion, Apple Notes, Google Drive import, AI linking) is not included, only a PROMPT.md prompt for Claude.
intentEvidence: It is only the visual. It has no note-taking app, AI or sync built in.
problem: Obsidian offers no spatial 3D overview of a vault, so the overall shape of a large note collection is hard to take in at a glance.
summary: 3D visualization that renders vault notes as stars orbiting a black hole, grouped by folder, tag or links, with click-to-open notes.
